title: Browser Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your browser data from companies. Protect your privacy with our customizable letter for Chrome, Firefox, Safari users.
description: A customizable letter template to formally request information about your browser data collection, tracking practices, and privacy settings from web browsers and online services.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Formal Request
sections.content:
Subject: Browser Privacy Data Request - [Your Account/User ID]

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to formally request information about the personal data your organization collects through my browser usage, in accordance with applicable privacy laws including GDPR, CCPA, and other relevant data protection regulations.

My browser details:
- Browser: [Browser Name and Version]
- Operating System: [OS]
- Account Email: [Associated Email]
- User ID (if known): [User ID]

placeholders.label: Browser Name (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Brave, etc.)

sections.heading: Specific Data Categories Requested
sections.content:
I specifically request access to the following categories of personal data collected through my browser:

1. Browsing history and website visits
2. Search queries and search history
3. Cookies and tracking data stored
4. Browser fingerprinting information
5. Location data collected through browser
6. Downloads and file access history
7. Extension and plugin usage data
8. Synchronization data across devices
9. Crash reports and diagnostic data
10. Any profiles or behavioral analysis created about me

sections.heading: Additional Privacy Information Requests
sections.content:
Additionally, please provide:

- A complete list of third parties with whom my browser data has been shared
- Information about data retention periods for different types of browser data
- Details about any automated decision-making or profiling based on my browser usage
- Current privacy settings applied to my account/browser profile
- Information about any data breaches that may have affected my browser data
- Instructions on how to opt-out of data collection or delete my data entirely

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights as a data subject under applicable privacy laws. I understand that you have [30/45] days to respond to this request as required by law.

If you require additional information to verify my identity or process this request, please contact me at [Your Email] or [Your Phone Number].

I would prefer to receive this information in electronic format via secure email. If the data is extensive, please provide it in a structured, commonly-used, machine-readable format.

sections.heading: Closing and Signature
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your prompt response and to better understanding how my browser privacy is being protected.

If you need any clarification regarding this request, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
